answer: Admission is a live geographic race, not a cheap essay dump. The claimant stakes 1.14 POA for five epochs and reserves one ridge slot on a 512-lane public height map, writing a 40-byte commitment tied to that slot and a single island index. Over the next 18 hours a coordinator turns a rotating mirror that reveals three unexpected 12-byte nonces; each must be signed within 45 seconds and bind the previous nonce. Cloned keys cannot precompute the nonces or sign a lane they do not hold. A missed nonce, reused island, or late signature burns 70% of the stake and freezes that slot for four epochs.
